data.export.label: Export

detector.caveat.stance: A high signal means that the result is unusual against its local baseline; it does not establish fraud. Read it with the sample size, score or p-value, and the section's context.
detector.caveat.title: How to read this
detector.clustering.caption: Each group against a {model} null, corrected across the family at q = {q}.
detector.clustering.family.label: {level} · round {round}
detector.clustering.none-survived: No group's concentration survived correction for multiple testing.
detector.clustering.not-computed: Not computed in this export: there is no composite high set to test.
detector.clustering.survived: {groups} groups held more of the high set than chance explains.
detector.clustering.table-caption: Groups tested for concentration of the high set, by level and round.
detector.clustering.title: Is the high set concentrated?
detector.composite.caveat: The composite summarises available statistical signals; it does not add up evidence and excludes distribution screens. Clustering shows where further context is warranted, not what caused the pattern, and may be uncomputed when too few indicators are available.
detector.composite.lede: Combines the mean-rank percentiles of available indicators for each section and round, requiring at least two. It then tests whether the highest-signal 1% is more concentrated in electoral zones or municipalities than random allocation would predict.
detector.composite.name: Composite indicator
detector.digits.caption: {counts} vote counts in {uf}, by size stratum and test.
detector.digits.caveat: Digit tests on election returns can produce false positives and false negatives and are sensitive to precinct size and districting. A low p-value describes disagreement with the reference distribution; it is not evidence of fraud.
detector.digits.lede: Within each state and municipality-size stratum, compares second digits with Benford's distribution and last digits with a uniform distribution. This is a distribution screen reporting n, χ², and a p-value for each stratum; it does not score sections.
detector.digits.name: Digit distribution
detector.digits.no-frequencies: This stratum carries no digit frequencies.
detector.digits.no-strata: This state has no digit strata in this export.
detector.digits.not-computed: This export carries no digit tests for {uf}.
detector.digits.skipped: No test was computed for this stratum: {reason}
detector.digits.title: Digit frequencies against their expectation
detector.distribution.caption: The {shown} ranked rows above, by signal. Not the full scored population.
detector.distribution.single-value: Every ranked row carries the same signal ({value}), so there is no distribution to draw.
detector.distribution.title: Signal distribution
detector.extreme-dominance.caveat: A rare tail under the beta-binomial model does not identify what caused the result. Small sections and municipalities with few sections need particular care; the page therefore shows n and whether the fallback state baseline was used.
detector.extreme-dominance.lede: Estimates how extreme a presidential candidate's result in one section is against the other sections in its municipality, using a beta-binomial baseline that allows natural variation. The score is −log10 of the smaller tail probability; higher values are more unusual locally.
detector.extreme-dominance.name: Extreme dominance
detector.fingerprint.caption: One cell per 1 % × 1 % bin; shading is the number of sections in it.
detector.fingerprint.caveat: The chart's shape may reflect electorate composition, section size, and regional patterns. Even corner mass does not establish its cause; absence of that pattern does not validate an election, and an uncomputed export is not the same as a computed screen with no signal.
detector.fingerprint.chart-label: Turnout against the leader's share of valid votes, {uf}.
detector.fingerprint.lede: Shows the joint distribution of turnout and the national winner's share of valid presidential votes for each state and round. The share of sections above 90% on both axes summarises the chart's corner; this screen neither scores nor ranks sections.
detector.fingerprint.name: Election fingerprint
detector.fingerprint.no-sections: No section in this state was observable on both axes.
detector.fingerprint.not-computed: This export carries no fingerprint for {uf}.
detector.fingerprint.title: Turnout against the leader's share
detector.kind.distribution.finding: This screen produces no per-section score: it reads one distribution per state.
detector.kind.distribution.label: Distribution screen
detector.kind.section-score.label: Per-section indicator
detector.ranking.caption: The {shown} highest-scoring rows of {scored} scored.
detector.ranking.empty: This export ranked no rows for this indicator.
detector.ranking.none-reached: No row reached this indicator's flag threshold ({threshold}). The order below is signal strength, not a finding.
detector.ranking.table-caption: Sections ranked by this indicator's signal, highest first.
detector.ranking.title: Highest-signal sections
detector.round.label: Round
detector.split-ticket.caveat: Divergence can arise from candidate-centred voting, local alliances, or differences between races. The municipal comparison absorbs recurring regional patterns, but distance from the median remains a prompt for context, not a conclusion about cause.
detector.split-ticket.lede: For each first-round section, compares the two leading presidential candidates' shares with the federal-deputy shares of their coalition parties. Distance is measured against the municipality's median and MAD, with a state baseline when the municipal sample is insufficient.
detector.split-ticket.name: Split-ticket divergence
detector.t1-arithmetic.caveat: A failure shows that the fields published for that section do not reconcile with one another; it does not explain why. Missing inputs are not treated as violations: they are excluded from scoring and counted separately.
detector.t1-arithmetic.lede: Checks whether nominal, party-list, blank, and null votes add up to turnout, whether turnout does not exceed registered voters, and whether counts are non-negative. Each failed identity adds one point to the section.
detector.t1-arithmetic.name: Arithmetic consistency
detector.t1-presence.caveat: A missing expected race is an inconsistency across published files or results, not an explanation for it. The race matrix is derived for each state and round, so a contest that legitimately did not take place is not marked missing.
detector.t1-presence.lede: Checks whether a section that reported one race also reported every other race observed for that state and round. Its score is the number of expected races that are missing.
detector.t1-presence.name: Cross-race presence
detector.turnout.caveat: Very high or low turnout may reflect local conditions, small sections, or administrative variation. The signal measures distance, not cause; when the municipal reference is too small or has zero MAD, the state baseline is used and identified.
detector.turnout.lede: Compares each presidential section's turnout with the municipal median, using MAD to resist outliers. The score captures departures in either direction and is shown with the sample size and baseline used.
detector.turnout.name: Turnout outliers
detector.uf.label: State
detector.unknown.body: This site has no page for “{id}”.
detector.unknown.title: Unknown indicator
detector.urna-model.caveat: This is an observational comparison limited to municipalities containing both generations and to the loaded export. Even the within-municipality interval cannot control every difference between sections, establish causation, or support a national conclusion from one state.
detector.urna-model.lede: Compares Bolsonaro's second-round share on pre-2020 urnas (electronic voting machines) and the 2020 model within the same municipalities. The result is an aggregate estimate with a 95% confidence interval, not a per-section score.
detector.urna-model.name: Urna model
detector.urna.caption: The same comparison, before and after holding the municipality fixed.
detector.urna.chart-label: Raw gap and within-municipality gap, on the same scale.
detector.urna.models-caption: Sections and votes by machine generation.
detector.urna.not-computed: This export carries no urna-model comparison for {uf}.
detector.urna.raw-gap.hint: The raw gap confounds machine model with geography: urna generations were not distributed randomly across Brazil. The relevant estimate compares generations within the same municipalities.
detector.urna.title: Raw gap against the within-municipality gap
